scope: Rank32 repair only, all six frozen directional maps, all M41/M42 task and natural evaluation inputs. Mean-only control already measured in M42, not perturbed here.
construction: retained_write + amplitude * frozen_missing_prediction + Down_bias; prediction fixed from intact retained native half. Native reference and live downstream.
hypotheses: Negative small-step output KL slope plus harmful full step is consistent with overshoot along this direction; positive stable small-step slope supports immediate directional mismatch. Neither identifies semantic units or proves a global quadratic model.
derivative: Central finite differences at .01 and .001 around deletion. Mark scale agreement only if absolute slope difference / max(abs(slopes),1e-8) <= .1. Report all rows and ambiguous cases; not all finite slopes are derivatives.
selection: Fixed amplitudes, no best amplitude chosen, no new map fitting, no dropping families or near-zero slopes. Original whole-task exclusions preserved.
stopping: One directional diagnosis, then synthesize mechanism account before additional experiments. Do not optimize repair amplitude on evaluation data.
